CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 01 / 10

Consumer and producer surplus

Willingness to pay and CS願付價格與消費者剩餘

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Interpret willingness to pay, the demand curve and the marginal buyer. Compute consumer surplus as willingness to pay minus the price paid, summed over units purchased.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

願付價格是每單位最高估值。只買價值至少等於價格的單位；CS 把已購單位的價值減付款加總，需求線顯示邊際買家估值。

Willingness to pay is a buyer's maximum valuation for a unit. Buy units valued at least as highly as the price. Consumer surplus sums WTP−price over units purchased; the demand curve shows the marginal unit's valuation.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：WTP for three units is 7,5,3 and P=4. Buy two; CS=(7−4)+(5−4)=4.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

WTP is 9,6,2 and P=5. CS? 願付九、六、二，價格五？
